Gabriel announces in heaven whom Allah loves; angels talk in the clouds as devils eavesdrop for soothsayers, record Friday arrivals at the mosque, and Gabriel supports Hassan's verses.
Gabriel greets Aisha, descends only by Allah's order, reads the Quran in seven ways, leads five prayers and says those dying without associating others enter Paradise; angels come in shifts.
Angels pray for those awaiting prayer; Malik keeps Hell; the Prophet declines the Angel of the Mountains' offer to crush his people, and saw Gabriel's real form with 600 wings.
Gabriel talked with the Prophet while Um Salama was present, and she took him for Dihya until she heard the Prophet speak of Gabriel in his sermon.
When Allah decrees a matter the angels beat their wings in obedience; eavesdropping devils pass snatches down, unless a flame strikes, to a sorcerer who adds a hundred lies.
The Prophet asks Gabriel why he does not visit more often, and the verse is revealed that the angels descend only by their Lord's command.
When Allah decrees in heaven the angels beat their wings in submission, while devils eavesdrop in a chain, passing words to fortune-tellers who add a hundred lies.
Angels of the night and day meet at the Asr and Fajr prayers; those ascending tell Allah, who knows best, that they left His slaves praying and found them praying.
The Prophet asked Gabriel why he did not visit more often, and the verse came down that the angels descend only by the command of his Lord.
When Allah decrees a matter in heaven, angels beat their wings at His word; when their fear passes they ask what their Lord said and are told the truth.
When Allah loves someone He tells Gabriel, who loves him and announces it in the heavens, then earth's people welcome him; angels of night and day report His slaves praying.
